title: Great views
text: I had an incredible boat experience along Barcelona's coastline. Thank you, Emma, for making it unforgettable. Nice views and Emma's was very kind. Highly recommend!
author: Legionhgn

title: Different and interesting experience
text: Great experience we had. The snowfall was very pleasant, and the wine tasting spectacular! We compare 2 same wines preserved in totally different places, one in a winery and the other under the sea! And they really tasted different! Very interesting! We totally recommend the experience!
author: ZenOmm

title: Amazing experience
text: Incredible experience with Sailing Tours Barcelona. The perfect organization and team. We had a great time! I recommend it 100%
author: martaa98

title: Boat and underwater wine tasting What else?
text:
A super recommended boat activity, a nice boat and good wine. The boy who made the tasting explained everything about the process of maturing wine under the sea and being able to check the difference with other wines that mature in traditional wineries. We didn't even know there were underwater holds! 
As for the boat, a very nice boat, well kept and the captain was attentive to us at all times.
author: Serendy88

title: 🍷 Wine & Sailing = Perfect
text:
Great attention onboard❗️
And the winetasting is a Must🍷... sail the Sunset, while exploring new wine, an experience!
author: Fede-Reiseleiter

title: Super fun
text: Super recommended to go with friends, super well organized. Better to live the experience. We'll repeat very safely. Thank you very much Emma!
author: Carlos S

title: One of the best experiences I've had
text:
This experience greatly exceeded my expectations. Seeing Barcelona from the sea is undoubtedly an experience that stays in your memory, but doing it in the right place ensures that nothing can go wrong. It's amazing the result when a team knows exactly what they're doing. From the very beginning, they kindly answered all my questions before making the reservation. The boat ride couldn't have been better. Watching the sunset from the sea made it an idyllic experience.

I have sailed with other companies, but I have never felt so well taken care of. Every little detail is perfectly thought out,
author: Ana_A
